review_scope: Bounded source and assertion review at b901326c. Neither whole-clause nor whole-ADR certification. Draft/run statements describe reviewer handoff; current execution and parent qualifications are in findings.json and gate-results.json.

reviewer_record.baseline: b901326c (worktree HEAD 9a54effa is one audit bookkeeping commit above it)

source.errata: EC3 source PDF checked directly; errata_annotations.json has no substantive annotation for either clause (the matches are table-of-contents entries only).
source.scope: No current scope-ratification exclusion found for either clause.

features.requirement: Decode Group 3 or Group 4 facsimile data per T.4/T.6; output is bilevel image samples (Table 87 also requires 1-bit samples).
features.implementation: crates/pdf-model/src/image/ccitt.rs::ccitt_bilevel -> pdf_sandbox::Request::Ccitt -> crates/pdf-sandbox/src/decode.rs::ccitt -> custom crates/pdf-ccitt decoder; image decode unpacks one bit per sample.
assertions: crates/pdf-ccitt/tests/coding.rs (T.4 figure cases and direct row assertions)
features.verdict: route and selected assertions reviewed; full T.4/T.6 code-space audit and test execution remain outside this shard

features.requirement: Bit-oriented stream; unencoded lines are padded to byte boundaries; encoded data is ordinarily continuous; EncodedByteAlign optionally skips zero fill to a byte boundary before each encoded line; at EOD skip to next byte boundary.
features.implementation: crates/pdf-ccitt/src/lib.rs::Decoder::run and bits.rs alignment/bit reader; inline extent is separately found by pdf-syntax filter helpers.
features.residuals: The aligned-lines unit fixture does not combine EOL, fill and byte alignment; no assertion here independently establishes every bit-boundary combination.

features.requirement: No error correction or resynchronization, except Table 11 DamagedRowsBeforeError.
features.implementation: Custom decoder reports first damage beyond tolerance; it only searches for EOL when concealment applies. Worker retains delivered rows and reader leaves later rows unpainted and reports shortfall.
features.verdict: implementation and source-level assertions reviewed; visual fill after filter error is a documented reader policy, not specified by 7.4.6

features.requirement: Table 11 K: negative=Group 4, zero=Group 3 1D, positive=Group 3 mixed; distinguish sign only; default 0.
features.residuals: No independently reviewed assertion compares two distinct positive K values on the same valid mixed-mode bitstream.

features.requirement: Table 11 EndOfLine: EOL patterns always accepted; when true they shall be present; default false.
features.implementation: Decoder::end_of_lines recognizes EOL regardless of flag; flag is forwarded from DecodeParms. Decoder does not enforce EOL presence except while DamagedRowsBeforeError is actively locating damage.
features.residuals: The 'shall be present' sentence is producer-side input validity. Do not infer a required reader refusal from the current lack of enforcement.

features.requirement: Table 11 EncodedByteAlign: true skips extra encoded bits to start each line at a byte boundary; false default.
features.implementation: DecodeParms default false; worker passes flag to pdf-ccitt; decoder aligns before line/EOL processing.
features.residuals: No PDF reader-level test was seen for byte alignment; worker unit test covers the actual decoder.

features.requirement: Table 11 Columns: pixel width; if not divisible by 8 adjust unencoded width to next multiple of 8; default 1728.
features.implementation: ccitt_bilevel reads default 1728, accepts image Width or its byte-rounded width, decodes at Columns, and image unpack reads Width samples on same padded stride.
features.residuals: Rejecting differences larger than padding is a cross-clause consistency interpretation (§7.3.8.2), not a separate explicit rejection sentence in §7.4.6.

features.requirement: Table 11 Rows: height in scan lines; absent/zero means height not predetermined and data terminates at EOB or filter-data exhaustion; default 0.
features.implementation: ccitt_rows uses PDF image Height when Rows=0, and Height when EndOfBlock=true; uses stated Rows only when EndOfBlock=false.
features.residuals: Potentially conflates image grid Height with filter termination: with EndOfBlock true it bounds worker rows to Height, while the table says EOB overrides Rows. The current test end_of_block_true_ignores_a_short_rows_and_draws_the_whole_image uses FOUR_BLACK_LINES without Group 3 RTC/EOB and expects silent completion. This establishes sample handling of Rows, not correct handling of a required EOB. Whether ignoring bytes after the image grid is acceptable for mismatched image/data is unresolved; do not call the assertion a valid EOB control.

features.requirement: Table 11 EndOfBlock: default true expects EOFB/RTC appropriate to K and overrides Rows; false stops on Rows or input exhaustion, whichever first.
features.implementation: Group4 expects two EOLs as EOFB; Group3 expects six as RTC; EOB false stops on stated effective row bound or exhaustion.
features.residuals: The direct EOB test checks row counts on streams containing EOB, but no PDF integration case reviewed combines a valid RTC/EOFB with Rows less than data-row count and proves EOB overrides Rows. The current paired Rows fixture omits EOB under true.

features.requirement: Table 11 BlackIs1: 1 means black and 0 white, reverse of normal PDF sample convention; default false.
features.implementation: Worker CcittRows applies the flag while packing runs; default parsed false.
features.verdict: strong sample assertion: same encoded bytes, output rasters are exact complements

features.requirement: Table 11 DamagedRowsBeforeError: default 0; applies only for EndOfLine=true and K>=0; find damaged row end at EOL and copy previous clean row, otherwise white.
features.implementation: pdf-ccitt enforces the applicability predicate and concealment; worker reports delivered/concealed counts; reader reports the choice.
features.residuals: The prior-row/white substitution is asserted with hand-encoded T.4 lines. A full independent audit of the T.4/T.6 coding repertoire is not claimed.

features.requirement: Notes 1-4: monochrome-only use (Note 1), encoding details deferred to ITU (Note 2), byte-fill convenience note (Note 3), compression ratios (Note 4).
features.implementation: Reader emits bilevel rows; T.4/T.6 code is in pdf-ccitt. Notes 3-4 make no separate reader behavior requirement.
assertions: ccitt.rs exact complement and raster output
features.verdict: notes distinguished from normative requirements; no blanket codec certification

features.requirement: Decode ISO/IEC 14492:2019 JBIG2, excluding colour palette coding; PDF image XObject data is bitonal; no segment type 54; all segment/file COLEXTFLAG values zero.
features.implementation: pdf-model::jbig2_bilevel sends image stream and globals to hayro_jbig2::Image::new_embedded; returns bilevel; output is unpacked as 1-bit samples. Codec pinned to close2/hayro commit documented in ADR 2102.
features.residuals: The T.88 Annex K harness is informative evidence and not a normative oracle; producer exclusions do not by themselves imply a reader must reject an out-of-scope input. The shared-family equality test can pass if every decode is the same wrong image; ISO sample has only structural/geometry assertions, not full expected sample bytes.

features.requirement: Only page 1 of a multi-page JBIG2 bitstream is used for a PDF image XObject; globals may be shared across XObjects.
features.implementation: Each request is one embedded page stream plus separately decoded JBIG2Globals stream; dimensions checked against image dictionary.
features.residuals: No reviewed reader-level fixture shares one globals stream across two image XObjects or discriminates a multi-page framed source.

features.requirement: JBIG2Decode shall not be used with inline images.
features.implementation: No reader rejection; inline-image machinery may still route bytes through filter decoder.
assertions: No clause-specific negative reader test found
features.verdict: producer requirement; no reader rejection required on this evidence

features.requirement: Embedded PDF organization: D.3; no optional 2-byte marker; sequential D.1; omit file header/EOP/EOF; image stream carries page's segments with page association rewritten to 1; page-0 segments in a separate JBIG2Globals stream even for a single reference.
features.implementation: Worker passes streams to new_embedded(data, globals); PDF dictionary resolution reads JBIG2Globals stream and decodes its own filters; the ISO worked-example constants split page and global segment streams.
assertions: crates/pdf-sandbox/src/decode.rs unit tests for whole-segment truncation
features.residuals: The standard-supplied split is tested at worker protocol, not through Document/image rendering. Exact-xref reader integration draft supplied in this shard. Segment-order recommendation (Note 3) is not a MUST.

features.requirement: Table 12 JBIG2Globals is optional stream containing global/page-0 segments; stream shall be separate even if only one image refers; may be shared.
features.implementation: pdf-model/src/image/jbig2.rs resolves key through Document::get_key, decodes stream filters, and passes bytes; malformed provided stream reports. A present non-stream value currently falls through as absent.
assertions: ISO example's split worker test; no reviewed PDF-level type/indirect-ref/shared-stream assertion
features.residuals: Table 12's value type is stream; how reader handles malformed wrong-type optional values is not specified as a required rejection in the clause.

features.requirement: Notes: informative bit-plane description, decoder behavior defined by JBIG2 standard, no standard encoder, image characteristics/caution, multi-page/global use context, segments in increasing order recommended.
features.implementation: Codec delegates decoding to pinned JBIG2 implementation; no encoder in scope.
features.verdict: informative notes and recommendation separated from SHALL requirements

features.requirement: Clause worked example: 52×66 image; split globals/page streams; Filter chain ASCIIHexDecode then JBIG2Decode; ASCIIHex source and globals contents are printed.
features.implementation: Worker test embeds printed bytes as direct Request::Jbig2 and asserts 52×66, nonblank/non-solid output and two same-sized, non-square marks.
features.residuals: Worker-only test does not exercise PDF parsing, exact xref, filter cascade, DecodeParms resolution, dictionary dimensions, or color/unpack. Draft reader integration fixture is provided; it uses geometry assertions because the printed example does not publish a sample bitmap.

reviewer_record.test_changes_since_prior: No tracked change in the reviewed codec, reader, worker, or test paths between b901326c and audit HEAD 9a54effa. This shard reviewed baseline assertions; no test was run here.
